work.title: Walden

pages.title: The first of the month · 1/3
paragraphs: It is the first day of the month in Denver. Leo wakes up early with a check in his hand. He walks down the hall to his landlord’s door. The door has a small brass number and a green plant. He knocks twice and waits. A woman named Ana opens it with a friendly smile.
“Hello, Leo! Is it rent day?” says Ana. “Yes. When is the rent due?” says Leo. “It is due on the first of every month.” says Ana.

pages.title: The first of the month · 3/3
paragraphs: “Thanks. The kitchen faucet is a little slow, and the heater is noisy.” says Leo. “I call a repair person tomorrow.” says Ana. Ana puts the check in a small box on her desk. She writes the date on a paper receipt. Leo folds the receipt and puts it in his wallet. He tells her about the faucet and the heater. She writes a note on a yellow pad. Paying on time keeps a landlord happy.
